ROW.COLUMN: (ML/EN) External Entity Associated with Multiple, Recurring Addresses

Money launderers may attempt to conceal their true identity by providing false addresses. Launderers and their agents may utilize various (sometimes fictitious) addresses when purchasing or redeeming strings of monetary instruments, and sending or receiving funds transfers. They may repeatedly utilize the same address, which is often a drop location. This scenario identifies possible attempts to conceal the true identity of the parties involved by providing false addresses when purchasing or redeeming monetary instruments, and sending or receiving electronic transactions.

The following approach has been followed while implementing the scenario. [1] Datasets for each party role in each of the Monetary Instrument transaction table and the Wire transaction tables obtained for the lookback period.
[2] Union of all the tables is obtained to get a dataset integrating data for different party roles across tables.
[3] For each External Entity involved in each of the transactions, apply check conditions.
